title: `voids/biological-cognitive-closure` now contradicts itself — the 2026-11-14 B1 fix (L69) records that the Mysticism Scale's structure FAILS in Indian and Tibetan/Chinese Buddhist samples (MacLean et al. 2012) and that Stace-derived agreement is partly supplied by the instrument, but the description, the lead (L53 "converge on … the same ineffable experiences"), L123 "The consistent phenomenology across traditions" and the Dualism paragraph (L137 "cross-cultural convergence on mystical ineffability may indicate encounter with aspects of reality") still lean on that convergence
